## Download the inputs

The complete project supplies the helpers and all files. Individual inputs are also available below; preserve the matching metadata and manifests when reusing them.

| Case | Measurements | Metadata |
|---|---|---|
| Airway | [Gene counts](data/cases/airway_counts.csv.gz) | [Paired samples](data/cases/airway_samples.csv) |
| Proteomics | [LFQ values and flags](data/cases/ubiquitin_lfq.csv.gz) | [Enrichment design](data/cases/ubiquitin_samples.csv) |
| Cattle | [RNA panel](data/cases/cattle_rna_panel.csv.gz), [metabolites](data/cases/cattle_metabolites.csv) | [Animal covariates](data/cases/cattle_samples.csv), [RNA totals](data/cases/cattle_rna_samples.csv) |

[Teaching-input checksums](data/cases/manifest.csv) · [Source checksums](data/cases/source_checksums.csv) · [Cattle identity audit](data/cases/cattle_identity_audit.csv) · [Cattle coding audit](data/cases/cattle_coding_audit.csv).

Licence texts: [DEP Artistic 2.0](data/cases/DEP-Artistic-2.0.txt), [airway LGPL 2.1](data/cases/airway-LGPL-2.1.txt), [LGPL 3](data/cases/airway-LGPL-3.txt) and [incorporated GPL 3](data/cases/airway-GPL-3.txt).
